focused_semantics.multi_target_boundary: The last explicit target changes by scale. Compare multi-target semantic digests only within a scale; cross-scale equality is not required.

interpretation_boundaries: This audit checks the evidence recorded by the frozen harness, not a new execution or an independent re-evaluation of RDF/SHACL answers.
The same frozen harness and settings are used on both binaries. Binary and output paths and kernel identities are intentionally different.
Successful semantic comparisons include warmups. Failed and skipped records provide no successful semantic digest or before/after speedup.
The before 1M fanout stage has no successful sample; its after digest can be checked against its oracle but cannot be paired with a successful before sample at that scale.
Session reuse counts cover successful validation requests including warmups; mounts and failed/skipped requests are excluded from those counts.
Each session mount is one diagnostic observation. Session request timing excludes that one-time mount; file transport includes per-call preparation.
OS caches were not flushed; raw reports carry the cache and scratch policies. These samples do not establish cold-disk latency, P95/P99, production concurrency or Full 100M capacity.
Small repeated samples support descriptive results, not statistical significance or a general claim that every join has constant memory or latency.

Temporary artifact paths are excluded from content equality; pack kernel identity is excluded because the measured engine intentionally changes. All recorded content/source/profile digests and logical/allocated bytes are still compared.

methods.canonical_hash_definition: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, compact separators and ensure_ascii=False

cache_policy.after: No OS cache flush. Generation, hashing and compilation precede queries. Full reads share one mounted private snapshot per artifact; each read still has an isolated worker. One-time mounts are separate diagnostic stages. Each read workload has one warm-up. Focused SHACL includes fixed-focus, multiple explicit targets and growing-join controls.

after.cpu_system_seconds: API worker self rusage, excluding supervisor CPU.
after.cpu_user_seconds: API worker self rusage, excluding supervisor CPU.
after.end_to_end_seconds: Before Popen through process exit and reading the result bytes; JSON parsing, oracle checks and artifact inspection excluded.
after.engine_seconds: Full compile worker phase before artifact publication; overlaps parse_dictionary_seconds and index_seconds.
after.execution_seconds: API supervisor boundary, including setup, verified snapshots and publication; excludes outer API parsing/final response writing. Not pure kernel time.
after.index_seconds: Full post-parse phase, including deduplication, indexes, ANALYZE/VACUUM and plan/import metadata; not index CPU alone.
after.io_read_bytes: Worker block-I/O accounting (ru_inblock * 512), affected by page cache; not logical input bytes.
after.io_write_bytes: Worker block-I/O accounting (ru_oublock * 512), not logical artifact size.
after.parse_dictionary_seconds: Full compile phase, including SQLite setup, RDF parse/dictionary insertion and rule constants.
after.peak_rss_bytes: API budget measurement combining worker RSS/HWM and supervisor RSS; not PSS and not directly comparable to pack compile process RSS.
after.peak_scratch_bytes: API sampled private scratch logical bytes (including detected deleted open files on Linux); not total bytes written.
after.process_cpu: wait4 command rusage user/system time; reaped-descendant accounting is OS dependent. Do not add worker CPU to these fields.
after.process_wait4_peak_rss_bytes: OS wait4 high-water RSS, not aggregate physical memory; Linux can include pre-exec inherited high-water state.
after.process_wall_seconds: Before Popen through wait4 completion. Serial command invocation, including startup and supervisor/worker lifecycle.
after.query_validate_core_seconds: Unavailable in the public API. Query/SHACL are measured end to end; no inferred core time is reported.
after.reasoning_seconds: Full materialization phase including SQLite setup, semi-naive joins, fixpoint and cleanup/ANALYZE/VACUUM.
after.session_lifecycle_rusage: wait4 counters after closing a session; lifetime measurements, not individual query/validation CPU or RSS. Do not add to worker measurements.
after.session_mount_seconds: Before starting api-session through receipt of READY; includes process startup, artifact verification and its private snapshot copy. Recorded separately, never amortized into request times.
after.session_request_seconds: Before writing a complete JSONL request through receipt of its response line; excludes one-time session startup/mount, JSON parsing and oracle checks. This replaces process-per-request end_to_end_seconds only when read_transport=session.
after.supervisor_peak_rss_bytes: Supervisor process high-water RSS, recorded separately; not additive to peak_rss_bytes.
